claim_scope: controlled simulator; fixed preparation options of 0,2,5 ticks plus a terminal tool; all deterministic time/cost is included; no real tool or autoregressive rollout qualification
compute_comparison: matched examples, optimizer opportunities, and approximately matched parameters; measured CPU is not forced equal
family_selection: maximum development net utility among GRU, diagonal SSM, dual timescale using independent selection training seeds before evaluation training
primary_endpoint: selected family minus single-step mean net utility including observed history, paired by independent training seed
utility: P(success and T<=deadline and C<=remaining_budget) - 0.03 E[C+prefix_cost] - 0.005 E[T]
